SELECT 
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN y.Consumption > 46.73 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT c.CustomerID) AS percentage
FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
WHERE c.Segment = 'LAM'

SELECT 
  CAST((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.CustomerID) FROM customers c JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID WHERE c.Segment = 'LAM' AND y.Consumption > 46.73) AS REAL) * 100 
  / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.CustomerID) FROM customers c LEFT JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID WHERE c.Segment = 'LAM') AS percentage
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CustomerID) as total_lam FROM customers WHERE Segment = 'LAM'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.CustomerID) as lam_with_consumption FROM customers c LEFT JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID WHERE c.Segment = 'LAM'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.CustomerID) as lam_consumed_over_46_73 FROM customers c JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID WHERE c.Segment = 'LAM' AND y.Consumption > 46.73

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT c.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) as total_consumption FROM customers c JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID WHERE c.Segment = 'LAM' GROUP BY c.CustomerID HAVING total_consumption > 46.73)

SELECT 
  CAST((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.CustomerID) FROM customers c JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID WHERE c.Segment = 'LAM' AND y.Consumption > 46.73) AS REAL) * 100 
  / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS percentage
